title: Seaside "Forget Me Not" 795 Forest Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Three-minute walk to the beach: Odessa Pavilion happens to be the least crowded beach in Seaside.- Steps from the family pool and Seaside Town Square.- New 2021 build - 4th-floor lookout tower- Professionally decorated- UV filtered HVAC system- Entire house water filtration system- Sound system in first floor living room, both primary bedrooms and in the lookout tower- 48 inch Thermador range- 2 Thermador dishwashers- Desk with chair in each bedroom- Wine fridge and stand-alone ice maker- 2nd-floor beverage fridge/coffee bar area- 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: “Forget Me Not” at 795 Forest Street has all the charm of Seaside, with the added luxury and function of new, high-end construction (completed Spring 2021). This professionally designed and decorated 4-bedroom plus bunkroom with 4.5-bathrooms home can sleep 12 guests comfortably and includes spectacular amenities such as a fourth story lookout tower with panoramic views of 30A and the Gulf. It is also just steps from the famous Seaside Town Square with plenty of shopping and dining and private beach access accessible through the Odessa Pavillion.The louvered entrance door on the street opens to a covered porch with a Carolina hanging bed as well as a built-in bench with cubbies. The garden includes a cozy gas fire-pit area, a gas grill, an outdoor shower, a dining area as well as a cornhole set.The elegant kitchen is open to the spacious living and dining areas which are flooded with natural light. It is fully stocked and features 2 Thermador dishwashers, a 48 inch Thermador gas range and a Thermador refrigerator freezer. The dining area comfortably seats 10 people and includes an ice maker and a wine refrigerator. The living area is spacious with plenty of comfortable seating for a large group. There is a half-bathroom and one primary bedroom on this floor, which has a king bed and private bathroom with a rain shower.The second floor includes three more bedrooms, including a another primary bedroom suite with a king bed and private bathroom with rain shower. A middle bedroom with another king bed and private bath with a bathtub. The final bedroom on this floor features a queen bed with a bathroom shared with the third floor bunk room. There is a wet bar along with a window seat with a view of mature oak trees. The second floor also features a well-appointed screened-in porch with a Carolina hanging bed, an outdoor sofa and four lounge chairs as well as ceiling fans.The spiral staircase leads to a third-floor bunk room with 4 beds (2 twins and 2 extra-long twins). The fourth floor features a large desk surrounded by windows and an outdoor lookout tower with unbeatable views of Seaside and the gulf. It is furnished with a comfortable sectional and is the perfect, quiet spot to read a book, take a nap or enjoy sunset cocktails and take in the views and ocean breeze.No detail is overlooked at 795 Forest Street. Each of the four bedrooms features a desk to allow for privacy while working remotely. There is a whole house water filtration system, UV light filtering HVAC system, a central vacuum system, sound system on the downstairs floor, both primary suites and in the lookout tower. It is the perfect home for girls trips or multi-generational families looking to make unforgettable memories in the heart of 30A!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Half BathroomSECOND FLOOR: - Second Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/ Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Bunk Area: Two Twin Beds and Two XL Twin BedsFOURTH FLOOR:- Lookout tower with desk and porch with gulf views
